shortlist_full.thesis: Established RWA leader with a hard, dated catalyst (July 2 launch of SEC-aligned tokenized US securities with Broadridge proxy voting) while price is still basing near $0.32 — an early Stage 1 accumulation setup, not extended. Wait for a volume-backed reclaim before adding; deep liquidity makes it a lower-manipulation bet in a risk-off tape.
shortlist_full.fundamentals: Ondo Finance tokenizes real-world assets (US Treasuries via OUSG/USDY, plus 430+ tokenized equities/ETFs through Ondo Global Markets). ONDO is the governance token. Sector: RWA/tokenization, a durable institutional narrative. Why now: first production deployment of the SEC's third-party custodial model in the US, giving token holders full shareholder rights.
shortlist_full.catalyst: July 2, 2026 launch with Broadridge enabling proxy voting and shareholder communications across 250+ tokenized securities, including tokenized BlackRock IVV and Micron shares on Ethereum; follows 24/7 minting (June 25) and Uniswap integration.
